dishes.name: Patatas Bravas
dishes.method:
INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Fill a medium saucepan with water and bring it to a boil.
2. As soon as the water boils, add the baking soda (it will foam a little). Carefully add the potatoes and allow the water to come to a boil. Boil the potatoes for about 1 to 2 minutes (no longer). Drain the potatoes well in a colander.
3. Transfer the potatoes to a large sheet pan and season then well with kosher salt. Toss to make sure the salt is well distributed, then be sure to spread the potatoes in one single layer.
4. Set the potatoes aside or transfer to the fridge to cool completely (you can do this ahead of time and leave the potatoes in the fridge overnight, but it’s important for them to cool completely).
5. In a medium skillet, heat 1 cup of the oil over medium-high heat. When the oil begins to bubble gently, add one piece of potato to test, if the oil around it bubbles a lot, it is ready. Add the rest of the potatoes and spread them out well. You may need to do this in batches so as to not crowd the pan. Cook in the oil, tossing occasionally and making sure the potatoes are well-coated in the oil, until they are golden brown on all sides, about 20 to 25 minutes. Watch them carefully, as they can go from perfectly cooked to burned in a short time.
6 Using a slotted spoon, transfer the potatoes to a tray lined with paper towels to drain excess oil. Immediately season with another pinch of kosher salt.
7. Finish with a good drizzle of bravas sauce and aioli of your choice (if using). Serve immediately with more bravas sauce to the side.

dishes.name: Salsa Brava
dishes.method:
INSTRUCTION:
1. In a medium pan or skillet, heat about ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil over medium heat. Add the garlic slices and cook, tossing around until the garlic has turned golden brown and the oil is just shimmering (about a couple of minutes).
2. Remove the garlic from the pan and discard or keep for other uses.
3. Lower the heat and add the tomato paste, smoked paprika, red pepper flakes and cornstarch, whisk to combine. Slowly add the vegetable broth and keep whisking until the broth is incorporated and the sauce has a smooth and somewhat creamy consistency. Add 1/2 to 1 teaspoon red wine vinegar, whisk again, and remove from the heat.
4. Transfer to a serving bowl or drizzle over your patatas bravas or transfer to a mason jar to store. Allow the sauce to cool before transferring to the fridge.

dishes.name: Tortilla
dishes.method:
1. Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Place the potato and onion in the pan and cook until the potatoes and fork tender. Stir occasionally to make sure they cook evenly.
2. Once the potatoes are fork tender, transfer the potatoes and onion to a bowl and discharge the excess oil.
3. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs until incorporated. Add in the potatoes and onion and stir to combine. Season with salt and pepper.
4. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in the sale skillet. Pour in the potato and add mixture into the pan.
5. Cook over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes until the bottom is golden brown.
6. Place a large round plate on top of the pan and hold it firmly. With the other hand, hold the skillet’s handle and quickly flip the omelette into the plate
7. Place the pan over heat again and slowly, push the omelette into the pan and cook over medium heat for another 8 to 10 minutes.
8. Once the other side is golden brown as well, the Spanish omelette is ready to serve.
9. Mix the tomatoes, cucumber, onion, olive oil, lemon juice and salt in a small bowl and serve it with the Spanish tortilla.

dishes.name: Filete Chuletón (hanger Steak)
dishes.method:
For MOJO VERDE (Spanish green sauce)
1. In a large dish, cover the ribeye with olive oil, salt and rosemary. Leave to marinade
2. Pan fry the beef to medium-high heat till all sides has some colour
3. Add garlic, cumin, cilantro, salt to the food processor and blend until it reaches the consistency of a taste.
4. Continue to run the processor on low and drizzle in the olive oil until well combined. Add the sherry vinegar and drop of water to loosen the mixture. Adjust seasoning if required by adding more salt.
5. When the beef is ready, remove from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before carving into thick slices.
6. Serve the beef with mojo, patatas bravas and ensalada mixta.

2. Other common additions to the filling includes fried onions, slices of crispy fried bacon, goat cheese, cabbage, pickles, butter, roasted red peppers and variety of sauces.

dishes.name: Bocadillo de Calamary
dishes.method:
1. The calamari are usually dipped in flour and fried in olive oil, while the sandwich’s filling may be enhanced with a touch of olive oil or aioli (garlic mayonnaise) or drizzle of fresh lemon juice.
2. This simple sandwich makes for a filling breakfast, lunch, dinner or afternoon snack. It is traditionally washed down with a small glass of ice-cold draft beer known as a Caña in Spanish.

dishes.name: Chili Pesto
dishes.method: METHODS: COOK CHILLI IN THE OVEN FOR AT LEAST 5 HOUSE IN 150 C. AFTER 1 DAY ADD 800 G VEGETABLE OIL AND BLEND TOGETHER.

dishes.name: Sofrito Sauce
dishes.method:
1. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Sauté the onions until the are translucent, about 7 mins. Add the green pepper and garlic, stir to incorporate.
2. Add the tomatoes and spices to the skillet and cook for another 10-15 minutes, stirring frequently, until the tomatoes have soften and the consistency has thickened slightly. Remove the bayleaf if used.
3. Use immediately or let it cool completely before storing in a jar for up to a week.

dishes.name: Bocadillo de Albóndigas
dishes.method:
1. The filling consists of Spanish meatballs, which are known as albondigas
2. The meatballs are usually made with pork, veal or beef, eggs, bread, onions, garlic, parsley, Manchego cheese, salt and black pepper, while the tomato sauce in which they’re cooked is typically flavoured with smoked paprika and red wine.

dishes.name: Malaga Salad
dishes.method:
1. Soak the salt cod for about 24 hours, depending on its thickness, Once its desalinated, dry the cod with paper towel and carefully remove any skin or bones.
2. Wash and peel the potatoes, put into large pot and cover with water. Cook over high heat and the sea salt right when the water boils. Good the potatoes until fork tender, about 20-25 minutes. Let it cool and the cut into bite0sized pieces.
3. When the potatoes are halfway done, hard boil 4 eggs, cooking about 10 minutes. Peel and cut the eggs inti bite-sized pieces.
4. Mix the potatoes, eggs, onion, orange slices, olives and salt cod in a large bowl
5. Dress with olive oil, sherry vinegar and sea salt to taste.
6. Serve the salad at room temp or chilled.

dishes.name: Ensalada Murciana (murciana Salad)
dishes.method:
1. Boil the eggs for about 10 minutes until the yolks are set. 3 to 4 eggs
2. Peeled the canned tomatoes if they are not already peeled. Then cut into small chunks inside the salad bowl to save their juices. 25 oz canned whole tomatoes.
3. Peel the outer layer of the spring onion and discard the green part. Dice finely and add to the bowl. 1 spring onion.
4. Peel the eggs and cut into quarters.
5. Drain the tuna and add it to the bowl. Also add the black olives, 1 canned tuna, 1 cup small black olives
6. Dress the salad with olive oil and salt. Mix well. 1/2 tbsp salt, 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
7. Garnish the salad with the rest of the boiled eggs on top and serve with lots of crusty bread to soak up the juices.

dishes.name: Pork Chop With Chorizo
dishes.method:
1. Place the pork chops in a bag and all the spices except the chorizo. Marinate for 24 hours.
2. Cut the chorizo into 1 - 1.5 cm dice.
3. Sear the pork chops both side till get the nicely colour 2-3 minutes. Transfer the pork chop to the oven cook at 180 C or 350 F for 8 -12 minutes.
4. Rest the pork chop and set aside to rest for 5 minutes
5. Serve with drizzle of the oil that has rendered out of the chorizo.

dishes.name: Bocadillo de Lomo
dishes.method:
1. Both sides of the bread are usually rubbed with ripe tomato halves and garlic cloves on the inside.
2. The sandwich filling can be enhanced with the additional of cheese, tomato slices, peppers, onions and Spanish tortilla (potato omelette)

dishes.name: Bacalao
dishes.method:
1. Path dry the cod and seasoned with salt and pepper. Deep in flour and fry in olive oil
2. Cut the piquillo peppers into cut into strips.
3. Sautéed the onion, garlic and pine nuts, after golden brown add the tomato sauce, frozen peas ad piquilli peppers and fresh parsley. Stir well co combine, after a minute, add the vegetable broth, 1 bayleaf and few strand of saffron.
4. Simmer for 5 mins then put back the cod fish to heat up.
5, For platting, put the veggie first and on top is the cod, garnish with chop parsley.

dishes.name: Bocadillo de Carne
dishes.method: When it comes to filling, the sandwiches may contain meat and a variety of Spanish salamis or sausages.
